scope: Source and coverage inventory for exactly the 194 countries with FLOW source estimates; not an assertion that 194 national migration datasets have been audited.

definitions.reporter: The country whose statistical authority reports the observation to the collector.
definitions.mirror: An observation reported by the other end of the migration corridor; it does not establish a complete national series for this country.
definitions.observationCount: Available source-specific country-pair-year rows, including numeric zero. Two source observations can describe the same route-year; these counts are not additive migration totals.
definitions.metadataReviewed: A primary-source page or indexed official document was inspected for source identity, metric and caveats. This is not an observation-level reconciliation.
definitions.candidate: A possible source requiring dataset, country, year, metric and quality verification before importing any values.
definitions.modelFallback: FLOW estimates remain available for route-years without a comparable official observation, and must be labelled modelled rather than recorded migration.

selectionPolicy.preferredMetric: Annual persons changing country of usual residence, previous residence for arrivals or next residence for departures; generally at least 12 months.
selectionPolicy.missingData: Missing/confidential/restricted is unavailable, never zero. A published numeric zero is retained.
selectionPolicy.mixedRange: A range using official and modelled observations must disclose the source coverage; do not label its whole sum as an observed official total.
selectionPolicy.mirrorConflicts: Do not add destination and origin reports for the same route-year. Prefer the destination report and retain conflicting observations and flags for inspection.

eurostat_imm5prv.label: Immigration by age group, sex and country of previous residence
eurostat_imm5prv.metric: Annual international changes of usual residence, persons
caveats: Official statistics can include national estimation, imputation, provisional values and breaks; the source flags must remain visible.
A reporting country and a partner country are different roles; partner observations do not establish a complete national migration series.
Absent, confidential or restricted observations are unavailable, not zero. Regional aggregates are not allocated to country pairs.
COMPLET age definition is preferred; REACH is used only when the preferred all-age value is unavailable.

eurostat_emi3nxt.label: Emigration by age group, sex and country of next usual residence
eurostat_emi3nxt.metric: Annual international changes of usual residence, persons
caveats: Official statistics can include national estimation, imputation, provisional values and breaks; the source flags must remain visible.
A reporting country and a partner country are different roles; partner observations do not establish a complete national migration series.
Absent, confidential or restricted observations are unavailable, not zero. Regional aggregates are not allocated to country pairs.
COMPLET age definition is preferred; REACH is used only when the preferred all-age value is unavailable.

unsd_incoming_previous_residence.label: UNdata: incoming international migrants by previous country of usual residence and sex
caveats: Country-year reporting is incomplete and has not been downloaded and reconciled in this implementation.
The collection description covers reference years 2010 onward as available; this is not a statement that every country or every year has data.
Duration definitions, administrative methods, sex totals and duplicate revisions require observation-level review before import.
unsd_incoming_previous_residence.metadataEvidence: Official UNdata search-index description verified; direct page fetch timed out during review.

undesa_flows_2015.label: International Migration Flows to and from Selected Countries: 2015 Revision
undesa_flows_2015.provider: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
undesa_flows_2015.metric: Historical national immigration/emigration series with heterogeneous definitions
caveats: The 45 reporting-country names are verified in the official documentation; this is membership, not an audit of every observation.
The historical release cannot supply the post-2020 Belarus displacement figures.
Country of citizenship, birth and previous/next residence are not interchangeable; a country-specific series must be reviewed before use as a residence flow.
undesa_flows_2015.metadataEvidence: Official documentation reporting-country list verified through its search-index text; direct document fetch returned HTTP 403.

oecd_international_migration.label: OECD International Migration Database
oecd_international_migration.provider: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
oecd_international_migration.metric: Annual foreign-population flows and asylum applications, stocks and nationality acquisitions
caveats: OECD foreign-population inflows by nationality are not bilateral movements by previous residence.
National definitions differ; for example, some series count residence permits, whereas others use population registers.
Neither OECD membership nor appearance as a nationality establishes country-year reporting coverage. Country-level data coverage has not been extracted here.

undesa_migrant_stock_2024.label: International Migrant Stock 2024
undesa_migrant_stock_2024.provider: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
undesa_migrant_stock_2024.metric: International migrant population living in a country at a reference date
caveats: Stocks for 233 countries and areas over 1990–2024 are not annual migration flows.
Differences between stocks include deaths, naturalisation, revisions and other changes; do not sum or treat stock differences as gross movements.

usa_dhs_lpr.label: Yearbook of Immigration Statistics 2024, lawful permanent residents
usa_dhs_lpr.provider: US Department of Homeland Security, Office of Homeland Security Statistics
usa_dhs_lpr.metric: Persons obtaining lawful permanent resident status during the fiscal year
caveats: Status grants include adjustments for people already living in the United States.
Permanent admissions exclude many temporary and unauthorised migrants and are not all changes of usual residence.
Fiscal years do not match calendar years; table 11 is grouped by last residence, while other tables use birth or other classifications.

usa_census_acs.label: American Community Survey geographical mobility and migration guidance
usa_census_acs.metric: Survey estimates of residence one year ago and current residence
caveats: The published migration-flow page primarily links domestic state/county/metro flows; it is not a ready-made complete world-to-US bilateral table.
A bilateral international extract would require detailed-table or microdata work, survey weights, uncertainty and geography verification.
ACS multi-year estimates are overlapping period estimates; they cannot be added as independent annual immigration totals.

can_statcan_components.label: Table 17-10-0014-01: international migration components, annual
can_statcan_components.metric: Estimates of international migration components by age and gender
caveats: Annual migration components are not a complete country-to-country previous-residence table.
Immigrants, emigrants, returning emigrants and non-permanent residents have different component definitions.

can_statcan_last_residence_historical.label: Immigrants to Canada by country of last permanent residence, historical table 17-10-0010
can_statcan_last_residence_historical.metric: Historical immigrant admissions by last permanent residence
caveats: This is a historical table with limited country/region categories, not verified complete modern bilateral coverage.
An immigrant-admission administrative definition may exclude temporary moves and include status changes.

can_ircc_permanent_residents.label: Permanent Residents – Monthly IRCC Updates
can_ircc_permanent_residents.metric: Permanent resident status admissions by country of citizenship and other characteristics
caveats: Country of citizenship is not previous country of residence.
Permanent resident admissions include people already living in Canada, and do not include every temporary migrant.
The portal marks some CSV resources rounded and not for calculations; resource-level rounding and suppression must be reviewed.

aus_abs_overseas_migration.label: Overseas Migration, 2023–24 financial year
aus_abs_overseas_migration.metric: Official overseas migration estimates using residence outcomes
caveats: The 12-month residence threshold is assessed within a 16-month period; revisions and provisional estimates are part of the official method.
The main country breakdown is country of birth, not necessarily previous residence.
A complete previous-residence country table and calendar-year compatibility must be verified before bilateral import; arrivals/departures travel events are a different series.

nzl_stats_migration.label: International migration: June 2024, country of last permanent residence data
nzl_stats_migration.metric: Estimated migrant arrivals using the 12/16-month residence-outcome rule
caveats: The release links a citizenship-by-visa-by-country-of-last-permanent-residence CSV; citizenship is not a substitute for last residence.
Not all last-residence responses are known. Provisional estimates are revised and the model training window changed in 2024.
Rolling-year totals overlap. Non-overlapping calendar periods, duplicate dimensions and final/provisional vintages must be reconciled before import.
An incoming last-residence table does not establish a complete outgoing next-residence series.

gbr_ons_long_term.label: Understanding international migration statistics
gbr_ons_long_term.provider: Office for National Statistics, United Kingdom
gbr_ons_long_term.metric: Official estimates of long-term international migration
caveats: Long-term migrants change usual residence for at least 12 months; administrative sources and estimation methods vary across populations and vintages.
Visa grants, nationality and country of birth are not previous/next residence flows.
Comparable UK observations are imported only where available in the archived Eurostat residence-flow tables; this methodology link is not a separate imported series.

isr_cbs_aliyah.label: Immigrants by selected last country of residence and first locality of residence in Israel, table 6
isr_cbs_aliyah.metric: Immigrants in the national immigration/aliyah statistical category
caveats: The national immigrant/aliyah category is not verified to include all international changes of usual residence.
Selected country rows do not establish complete worldwide coverage; release reference year and definitions require extraction before use.
Do not combine this category with broader migration estimates without labelling the difference.

pol_gus_permanent_migration.label: Main directions of emigration and immigration in 1966–2024: migration for permanent residence
caveats: Registration/deregistration for permanent residence is narrower than all people moving to live in Poland for at least one year.
Temporary residence, many work-related moves and some post-2020 Belarus migration are outside this permanent-registration measure.
Do not silently replace a harmonised long-term migration series with this narrower measure.

pol_udsc_administration.label: Migration statistics: permits, legal residence and protection
pol_udsc_administration.metric: Residence permits, documents and international-protection administrative statistics
caveats: Valid residence permits at a date are a stock of legal-status holders, not annual arrivals from Belarus.
Permits issued and visas issued are administrative events that can include renewals and people already resident.
These statistics are valuable contextual checks, but cannot be added to residence-flow counts or used to infer a previous-residence corridor.

col_migracion_movements.label: Flujos migratorios: administrative entries and exits
col_migracion_movements.metric: Recorded international trips at migration control points
caveats: The provider explicitly defines these flows as journeys, not distinct people: one traveller can make several entries/exits.
Trips include short visits and do not establish a change of usual residence.
Venezuelans intending to remain and residence/protection documents are separate metrics.

chl_sermig_permits.label: Open migration administrative data
chl_sermig_permits.metric: Temporary/permanent residence applications and decisions, and refugee procedures
caveats: The provider explicitly states the data count residence permits, not people.
Applications, grants, renewals and stocks of residents are different measures and must not be added as migration movements.

chl_ine_resident_stock.label: Estimated foreign usual-resident population, 2023 methodology
chl_ine_resident_stock.provider: Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas and Servicio Nacional de Migraciones, Chile
chl_ine_resident_stock.metric: Estimated foreign resident population at 31 December
caveats: The EPE series is a population stock; annual stock differences are not gross immigration.
Data integration and methodology changes affect comparisons between editions.

zaf_statssa_profile.label: Migration Profile Report for South Africa: A Country Profile, 2023
zaf_statssa_profile.metric: National migration profile combining multiple statistical and administrative sources
caveats: The existence of an official profile is verified; a complete annual bilateral previous/next-residence extract has not been verified.
Census migrant stocks, travel movements, legal permits and residence flows must remain separate.

jpn_isa_statistics.label: Immigration Services Agency statistics
jpn_isa_statistics.metric: Administrative entry/exit, residence examination and immigration procedures
caveats: The official statistics gateway is verified; a comparable annual all-person bilateral residence-flow table has not been verified.
Entry/exit events, residence statuses and foreign-resident stocks have different definitions.
